# NPCs: Marcy Baker (256390) at Three Corners, Redridge Mountains (live frame

step Azeroth Commerce Authority to Friendly
  only Alliance
  zone Redridge Mountains
  tip The Azeroth Commerce Authority is the Alliance's tradeskill faction in Forever. Its camp is at Three Corners in western Redridge Mountains. From level 10 mobs drop Waylaid Crates: fill each with the goods its label asks for and hand the Sealed Crate to Marcy Baker at the camp for reputation and Merchant's Favor. Forever's Legacy Diplomat perk increases reputation gains.
  goto 9.8,71.0 "Marcy Baker" live
